deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset signals are pulling in different directions today. Equities are softer and volatility is rising, consistent with a cautious tone, yet gold's mild gain sits alongside a slightly weaker dollar index and firmer yields, muddying the risk-off read. Bitcoin's small pullback adds a touch of caution without confirming a broad flight to safety. Oil's rise offers some support to commodity-linked currencies.
